articleTitle: Silicon Photonics I/O Nodes for HPC Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a silicon photonics (SiPh) node that is tightly-coupled to the compute node and uses an integrated photonic crossbar to implement optical pass-through links for building an all-to-all, always on, large scale, low latency, and switchless optical network for high performance computing.

articleTitle: Development of VCSELs for cyogenic (4.2 K) optical interfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Vertical cavity surface emitting lasers operating at 4.2K are developed for energy efficient optical links between cryogenic systems and room-temperature data storage systems. Design considerations, material models, and validation of required electro-optical-thermal models are presented. Successful operation at mA-level injection is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency of Amplification Technologies for Ultra–Wideband Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Low energy consumption has become an important requirement for telecommunication equipment. Amplification technologies for ultra–wideband transmission are compared with single-band solutions in view of their energy efficiency with a focus on the comparison of erbium–based amplifiers for C+L-band systems with the currently used C-band amplifiers.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Vibration Sensing and Positioning on Multiple Metropolitan Fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate on simultaneous polarization sensing on multiple fibers to detect and time-position anomalous vibration events. We experimentally demonstrate that our “threshold and cross-correlate” algorithm obtains timing with 40 ms rms accuracy when tested on deployed fibers (35km and 10km) in Turin urban area.

articleTitle: Silicon-Nitride Photonic Integrated Circuits for Atomic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present the development of a silicon-nitride photonic integrated circuit platform aimed at a range of miniature atomic systems including atomic clocks and cold atom sensors which includes narrow-linewidth (≤3.7 kHz) distributed feedback lasers and wafer-bonded MEMS rubidium vapour cells.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonics for Computing and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper, we review the progress of integrated photonics in both digital computing and analog neuromorphic computing. We introduce methods to design scalable, area-efficient, and energy-efficient integrated photonic computing chips for computing and artificial intelligence acceleration with experimental demonstrations.

articleTitle: Modeling optical amplifiers: from inverse design to full system optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical amplifiers play a critical role in the optimization of communication systems striving to achieve maximum throughput. Here, we review recent efforts in amplifier modeling – from physics-based to black-box modeling – for amplifier inverse design to full system optimization.

articleTitle: Study of W centers formation in silicon upon ion implantation and rapid thermal annealing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The recent demonstration of optically active telecom emitters in silicon has paved the way for realizing industrial-scale silicon-based solid-state quantum photonic platforms. The scientific community has been pursuing the implementation of novel single-photon devices for quantum technology applications by introducing extrinsic impurities inside the silicon lattice upon ion implantation. Here we report the optical characterization through single-photon microscopy of intrinsic W centers in high-purity silicon substrates upon carbon implantation and subsequent rapid thermal annealing. The photoluminescence investigation of their emission properties at cryogenic temperatures allowed us to identify the effects of the post-implantation thermal treatment in the formation of telecom quantum emitters based on interstitial silicon clusters upon the introduction of an extrinsic atomic species.

articleTitle: Multimode nonlinear integrated optics for quantum and machine learning-assisted signal processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Integrated optics offer advanced platforms for the development of new classical and quantum telecom-based applications. In this work, we leverage on-chip photonic devices that support multimode interaction via four-wave mixing, to develop novel, highly efficient, and secure smart technologies for telecom signal processing.

articleTitle: Machine learning assisted inverse design on mechanically tunable lateral hybrid metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI) has resulted in a surge of metasurface design for various purposes. Our latest work [1] has introduced the lateral hybrid system for the first time, where resonators composed of two different materials are placed horizontally next to each other to form a lattice. Such design demonstrates a sensitivity that is five times greater than conventional tunable metasurfaces. With this work, we have successfully implemented an AI-assisted design process to develop an optimized lateral hybrid metasurface for structural colour applications. Our results have demonstrated that the lateral hybrid concept can enhance the performance and optical tuning of various semiconductor and high dielectric metasurfaces, such as TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. This approach has the potential to unlock new opportunities for using metamaterials in high precision sensors with increased sensitivity, and represents a major step forward for the field.

articleTitle: Fiber Optical Sensing Utilizing Correlation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review the application of correlation for fiber optical sensing using direct or coherent detection. The Correlation-OTDR with direct detection provides a group delay measurement resolution in the order of a few picoseconds, while coherent detection enables dynamic event evaluation by analyzing the phase information.

articleTitle: Time-resolved mode power decomposition for nonlinear multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the mode power distribution from long spans of graded-index multimode fiber. We find that, at relatively low powers, linear random mode coupling leads to a Bose-Einstein mode distribution. At powers near the nonlinear soliton regime, the distribution approaches a modified Rayleigh-Jeans law.

articleTitle: Fiber seismic tomography for volcanic hazard and geothermal exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: For the first time, we present tomographic evidence demonstrating the fluid-driven nature of the unrest in the Long Valley caldera and the structures of its extended hydrothermal system, California, obtained using seismic data recorded along telecommunication fiber-optic cables.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic computing by means of recurrent spectrum slicing for next generation high baud rate transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper we review our recent work in photonic neural networks based on recurrent optical spectrum slicing as potential accelerators for the mitigation of transmission impairments in short reach, high symbol rate (>100 Gbaud) transmission systems. Results will focus on self-coherent receiver architectures.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach to Vibration Monitoring on a Metro Length Fiber Cable Using Low-Cost State of Polarization Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Monitoring polarization changes along fiber cables in operator networks based on polarization beam splitter is demonstrated. A section of the cable is spun on a high-voltage AC power line, inducing a strong 50 Hz. Modulation of the 50 Hz from other perturbating sources is observed.

articleTitle: Novel Approaches to Calibration and Programming of MZI-Based Optical Processors: Overcoming Challenges and Enhancing Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this presentation, we discuss challenges of calibrating and programming MZI-based programmable optical processors. We propose a novel architecture that tackles these issues, delivering faster and more energy-efficient programming while maintaining key performance metrics such as minimum insertion loss and resilience to fabrication imperfections.

articleTitle: Application of adaptive activation unit based on injection-locked lasers in machine learning tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The expressiveness and learning capabilities of neural networks depend on the activation functions nonlinearity. We present a concept of photonic device with nonlinear transfer function which can be flexibly reconfigured to optimize the performance of different machine learning tasks, such as classification or time-series prediction.

articleTitle: Chirped solitons and wavetrain solutions for Kerr-frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate that the interplay of higher-order dispersion and nonlinear effects excites propagation of ultrashort, nonlinearly-chirped signals in an optical fiber. These undamped excitations reproduce characteristics of Kerr-comb systems, including bright-solitons and periodic wavetrains, and possess chirp that depends linearly on the pulse amplitude.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated III–V on Silicon Photonics for Neuromorphic Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: At Hewlett Packard Labs, an energy-efficient, heterogeneous III–V on silicon photonics platform has been developed as the underlying device-level foundation for innovative neuromorphic computing architectures. The latest research on our III–V on silicon photonic neuromorphic device platform will be presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Applications of Double Injection Photonic Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Double Injection in ring resonators revealed unique programmability properties in both, modulator and filter operation modes. We present here further applications of the device, namely its incorporation in photonic networks and multiple frequency handling.

articleTitle: Prime comb lasing in a fiber ring at low temperatures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally study a fiber loop laser with an integrated Erbium doped fiber (EDF). The output optical spectrum is measured as a function of the EDF temperature. We find that below a critical temperature of about 10K the measured optical spectrum exhibits a sequence of narrow and unequally-spaced peaks. Externally injected light and filtering are employed for tuning the peaks’ wavelengths. Operation of the device as an optical memory having storage time of about 20ms is demonstrated. The multimode lasing tunability can be exploited for novel applications in the fields of sensing, communication, and quantum data storage. c 2023 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Towards an All-Silicon DV-QKD Transmitter Sourced by a Ge-on-Si Light Emitter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate the behavior of a Ge-on-Si light source and demonstrate its feasibility for polarization-encoded discrete-variable quantum key distribution following the BB84 protocol, enabling a potential “all-silicon” QKD scheme which can operate well below the necessary QBER limit and successfully generate secret keys.

articleTitle: Threshold in nanolasers: definitions, measurement, modelling and applications – Invited Paper
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Coherence, associated to the crossing of laser threshold, identifies lasing and is the defining property for most of the current laser applications. It is signalled by the change between Gaussian and Poissonian photon statistics. The threshold is poorly defined in nanolasers, where the transition between the two statistical regimes takes place over a broad pump range. This has led to confusion about the nanoscale threshold definition, as well to inconsistencies depending on the measurement techniques. A proper identification of the coherence onset depends on a more sophisticated modelling approach, where the properties of radiation “below” and “above” threshold are simultaneously taken into account. Furthermore, the mixed regime of emission holds promise for interesting and new applications.

articleTitle: Mode entanglement using multiple orbital angular momentum modes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We consider the potential for generating photon pars with high-dimensional entanglement in their orbital angular momentum through multiple simultaneous four-wave-mixing processes. We study a realistic fiber design and show that states with high entanglement negativity may be obtained.

articleTitle: All-Optical Activation Function Based on a Semiconductor Laser
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present an all-optical Leaky ReLU-like activation function, based on a semiconductor laser with optical injection in the vicinity of the Hopf bifurcation. The performance of a deep neural network using this optical function is comparable to the one using a standard Leaky ReLU function.

articleTitle: Machine learning for photonics: from computing to communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Neural networks are effective tools for learning direct and inverse models. Here, we review two specific applications of neural networks to photonics: (i) learning accurate direct models for optical matrix multipliers and (ii) inverse modeling for short-reach fiber communication systems, enabling signal equalization.

articleTitle: Parallel Photonic Reservoir Computing Based on Wavelength Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a parallel time-delay reservoir computing network based on four wavelengths of a Fabry-Perot laser in experiment. It is proved that the parallel scheme raises the clock rate of the network by four times and improves the performance on the nonlinear channel equalization task.

articleTitle: A Multisource-Multidetector Coherent Detection Scheme based on Binary Amplitude Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a coherent detection scheme that incorporates multiple coherent light sources and multiple detectors. We show that with fewer total number of well-calibrated sources and detectors, this system can encode the information of the target object with authenticity comparable to direct imaging.

articleTitle: Foundry SiN as a platform for Heterogeneous Integration at Visible Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Silicon nitride (Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) is an excellent material platform for visible wavelength photonic integrated circuits, in particular, as a host for the heterogeneous/hybrid integration of complementary materials. In this work, we characterise the performance of the Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> from LIGENTEC as a base for hybrid integration.

articleTitle: Monolithically Integrated Wavelength-meter in InP with measurement bandwidth of 100nm centered on the C band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper we will explore the creation of a monolithically integrated wavelength meter in InP. This type of devices are a key requirement for many applications and it is especially important to have them integrated with active components like lasers and gain sections. We present a wavelength meter based on multiple ring resonators that has been realized in a commercial MPW run and tested using a tunable laser.The designed circuit is theoretically capable of resolution down to 1.6pm and a measurement speed down to 500ps within a wavelength range of 100nm.

articleTitle: High-order dissipative solitons in Kerr resonators with parabolic potentials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We study the formation of high-order dissipative solitons in externally-driven Kerr resonators in the presence of radially symmetric parabolic potentials. To do so, we apply bifurcation analysis to purely dispersive and dispersive/diffractive cavities.

articleTitle: Integrated microwave photonics coherent architecture for Massive-MIMO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We develop a theory for processing Massive-MIMO RF signals optically. We propose an architecture, that has been fabricated, based on this theory using Mach Zehnder Interferometers, optical modulators, microwave photonic filters, and high-speed photodetectors.

articleTitle: Earthquake Epicenter Localization Using Fiber Optic Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Earthquake Early Warning Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for locating an earthquake epicenter that is faster than what we showed earlier. The new method incorporates time difference of arrivals of P waves to locate earthquakes. It provides enhanced early warning possibility by faster localization using distributed acoustic sending.

articleTitle: Deployed telecom cables with sensing capabilities thanks to sustainable interferometric approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Already deployed standard telecom cables can become sensitive to the environment thanks to simple, cost-effective and energy-efficient interferometric layouts, able to detect and even localize events such as traffic and damages in motorways and railways, and also monitor the integrity of the network infrastructure itself.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Spatial Mode Conversion Based on Spatial Cross Modulation Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In the computing process of spatial cross modulation, a genetic algorithm is used instead of an iterative algorithm to overcome the trade-off between insertion loss and modal crosstalk in spatial mode conversion. Simulation results show that the genetic algorithm can reach regions that an iterative algorithm cannot reach.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated building-blocks for rubidium cold atom systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report on integrated silicon nitride photonics at 780 nm with resonators over 100M Q for laser linewidth narrowing and mm-sized, intersecting beam emitters for rubidium atom cooling and trapping. We discuss prospects for integrating these components and controllable locked lasers into cold atom systems-on-a-chip.

articleTitle: Mode-Selective Silicon Photonic Signal Processing Using Wideband, High-Efficiency Mode Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Using temporal Talbot effect followed by nonlinear processing in a silicon-on-insulator waveguide, we achieved wavelength multicast of 32-Gbaud 64-QAM signal with programmable spectral spacings from 75 to 150GHz. The convergence of photonic processing in singlemode and multimode platforms is realized using wideband, high-efficiency mode converters.

articleTitle: Recent Advances of III-nitride Integrated Photonics Technology for Visible Light Applications : (invited)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic integrated circuit technology can enable new applications which are difficult to realize with discrete components. Recently, GaN-based LEDs, laser diodes, photodetectors, waveguides, modulators, and other photonic devices in visible light regime have been demonstrated. In this paper, several optical functions related to III-nitride integrated photonics technology will be discussed. Such on-chip integration will pave the path for many emerging functionalities and applications in communication, sensing etc.

articleTitle: On-chip temporal pulse pattern generation and fiber propagation: Multidimensional wave-packet control and characterization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review recent work using integrated and fibered platforms for advanced optical processing. We show that machine learning in photonics systems can be leveraged to generate custom optical wave-packets relevant for targeted applications and further discuss the extension of this approach within multimode fibers.

articleTitle: All-fiber triple frequency comb light source
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a triple-comb, frequency agile, all-fiber light source. We show that mutual coherence is preserved by using a triple-core fiber and that 1ps transform-limited pulses can be obtained.

articleTitle: Generation of non-classical light using semiconductor quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: With a suppressed-pump-noise configuration, we have observed broadband amplitude-squeezed states of light generated from a 1310-nm distributed feedback quantum dot laser at room temperature.

articleTitle: Quantum-Dot Sources for Single-Photon Emitter Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present the results of our investigations of molecular beam epitaxial growth of low-density quantum dots emitting in the telecommunication wavelength range (1.3 – 1.55 μm) based on InAs/InP and GaSb/GaAs materials systems. Our ultimate goal is to demonstrate single-photon emission from these quantum dots, using site-templating approach. © 2022 The Authors

articleTitle: Toward the optical control of cryogenic quantum technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We develop technologies for future cryogenics that enable scaleable electrical quantum technology. In particular, our goal is to replace electrical radio-frequency cables by optical fibers that allow fast data transfer between room temperature and cryogenics without the excessive heat conduction of electrical wiring.

articleTitle: Single-Mode, UV-Visible Guiding Hollow-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The flexible delivery of UV-visible light is vital for many applications. Here we report the development of a new fabrication approach that allows broadband UV-visible guiding hollow-core fibers, with performance levels that approach or exceed commercial single-mode fibers, to be produced.

articleTitle: Spatial coherence study of supercontinuum in multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We perform a detailed study of the spatial coherence of supercontinuum light generated in multimode fibers. We characterize the spatial coherence across the full spatial beam profile in both graded-index and step-index multimode fibers and observe a decrease of the coherence area with an increase of the injected pump power.

articleTitle: Wideband chaos from external cavity mode dynamics in a laser diode with phase-conjugate feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: High frequency dynamics and wideband chaos (>30 GHz) are captured from a laser diode with feedback from a phase-conjugate photorefractive mirror. Such dynamics emerge from external cavity modes, which self-pulsate at harmonic frequencies of the external cavity frequency.

articleTitle: Coherent Ising machine as a thermodynamic system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally observed a thermal phase transition of two-dimensional Ising model in a coherent Ising machine (CIM). The results indicate that the CIM well simulates the thermodynamic properties of the 2D Ising model that matches analytical and numerical solutions than the means field solutions.

articleTitle: Cold atoms in micromachined waveguides: a new platform for atom-photon interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We use atoms in micro-machined waveguides to demonstrate a new platform for atom-photon interactions. Such hybrid quantum devices are able to exploit the benefits of both, atoms and photons. Compact, robust atom-photon interfaces enable scalable architectures for quantum computing and quantum communication, as well as chip-scale sensors and single-photon sources.

articleTitle: Far-detuned frequency conversion beyond 3500 nm in a few-mode graded-index silica fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present both theoretical and experimental evidence of far-detuned nonlinear wavelength conversion towards the mid-infrared, namely beyond 3500 nm, in a few-mode graded-index silica fiber pumped at 1064 nm. Intramodal and intermodal four-wave mixing processes are carefully analyzed by means of the frequency-dependent propagation constants.

articleTitle: All-Optical ReLU as a Photonic Neural Activation Function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an alloptical rectified linear unit (ReLU) activation function for neuromorphic photonics applications enabled by optical frequency coding of signals. Furthermore, a comparison is made with an electro-optic approach building on a directly modulated laser.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonics for Trapped Ion-Based Quantum Computing and Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This talk will cover photonics integrated circuits (PICs) being developed at MIT Lincoln Laboratory for quantum applications, especially trapped-ion based quantum computers and optical clocks. We discuss optical signal routing, light collection for direct readout or remote entanglement generation, and laser and active component development.

articleTitle: Dispersion-diversity multicore fiber for reconfigurable microwave signal processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate reconfigurable microwave signal processing performed by a dispersion-diversity multicore fiber. The fiber comprises 7 different cores featuring the required chromatic dispersion values. As representative cases, this article gathers signal filtering, radio beam-steering in phased array antennas, frequency measurement and arbitrary waveform generation.

articleTitle: Excitation of semiconductor nanowires using individually addressable micro-LED arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical pumping of nanowire emitters, embedded in polymeric waveguides is achieved using a micro-LED array at 410 nm. The micro-LED-on-CMOS chip allows for individual pixel control and therefore parallel pumping of multiple emitters simultaneously. The nanowires are integrated on-chip using high-accuracy transfer-printing and laser lithography.

articleTitle: Modal Dispersion Mitigation in a long-haul 15-Mode Fiber link through Mode Permutation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally investigate a mode permutation scheme to mitigate differential mode delay impact in a long-haul 15-mode fiber link. The scheme reduces the rate of increase in the link’s intensity impulse response duration with transmission distance, minimizing delay spread between wavelength channels across the C-band.

articleTitle: Power Scaling of Dispersive Wave Generation using Higher Order Modes : (Invited paper)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate power-scaling of nonlinear frequency conversion in fibres via dispersive wave generation using higher order modes. By pumping in the LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,m</inf> modes at 1030 nm we show wavelength selectability between 550 and 800 nm with pulse energies up to tens of nJ.

articleTitle: Efficient All-Fiber Broadband Frequency Conversion via Intermodal Bragg Scattering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate effective frequency-conversion via intermodal Bragg-scattering. Conversion efficiency up to −3.6 dB is demonstrated between waves spanning almost 600 nm. All-fiber mode conversion is achieved using a long-period grating capable of converting between modes with an efficiency of 98%.

articleTitle: Intensity-only Detection and Decoding of Coherent Signals using a Photonics Spectrogram
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Processing coherent communication signals in the optical domain using the Time-Lens Spectrogram, we demonstrate the decoding of a 1 Gbaud/s QAM 16 signal with pre-FEC BER 7.5x10^-3, using only a single photodetector and simple decision algorithm, without any coherent detection, local oscillator, or interferometric system.

articleTitle: Spatial self-cleaning of laser beams with arbitrary state of polarization of light
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report on an extensive experimental study of the state of polarization of light during spatial beam self-cleaning in graded-index multimode fibers. Our results show that, depending on the experimental conditions, intense multimode beams with a bell-shape intensity profile can be obtained at the fiber output with a degree of polarization which ranges from a few percents to about 100%. These results extend the range of applications of the beam self-cleaning effect and provide novel useful insight for the understanding of the physical mechanisms behind the beam self-cleaning effect.

articleTitle: Temporal differentiation and integration based on a dispersion-diversity heterogeneous multicore fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, photonic temporal differentiation and integration on a customized dispersion-diversity 7-core heterogeneous multicore fiber. We successfully demonstrate up to 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order temporal differentiation and 7-sample temporal integration.

articleTitle: Multi-band Photonic Integrated WSS for 800G Optical Data Center Interconnect Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This study presents a networking performance analysis of a modular photonic integrated multi-band Wavelength-Selective-Switch (WSS), which can operate on multi-bands covering (S+C+L) bands. The WSS is designed for inter-data center applications, and its networking performance is analyzed for 800G transmission systems.

articleTitle: In-memory Photonic Tensor Core Accelerator for Neural Networks-based Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The growth of AI applications has pushed the need for new energy-efficient high-performance accelerators for computing Neural Networks at high speed. Here, we present our Photonic Tensor Core accelerator, which leverages photonics to compute MAC operation at high speed, and Phase Change Materials for reducing energy consumption. The resulting PTC is the key component for the next generation of AI systems.

articleTitle: Partial Parallelisation of MIMO Processing in Multi-Mode Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose partial-MIMO mode group division multiplexing (MGDM) to parallelize MIMO processing of spatial division multiplexing in multi-mode fibers. The digital signal processing required to overcome inter-modal crosstalk, applying mode group-based MIMO, is significantly reduced with respect to a full-MIMO approach, while preserving transmission performance.

articleTitle: Integrated diffractive neural networks performing optical inference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonics has been proposed as a paradigm shift for deep learning and, in general, machine learning, using photons instead of electrons for computation, since photonic hardware offers high-speed optical communication (speed of light in medium) and massive parallelism of optical signals (multiplexing in time, space, wavelength, polarization, orbital angular momentum, etc.) 1 . In particular, the idea of build artificial neural networks on top of an optical field propagating through free space or some medium has recently attracted a lot of attention, as it promises to pave the way for a future where optical hardware can process data and execute machine learning functionalities at the speed of light 2 .

articleTitle: Turning Zero-Bits of Parallel Interconnects into Optical Budget: Biasing APDs through Dumped Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We prove the graceful migration to avalanche photodetection through reclaiming power that is available at transmitters. We demonstrate a sensitivity of −26 dBm for continuous/burst-mode 10 Gb/s/lane transmission, together with an extension to 32 data lanes.
